property_summary: C.transfer returns true iff it successfully calls transferFrom on the target for every recipient and does not revert; if any internal call fails, the overall call reverts (no partial success).
For any non-empty _tos, calling transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false when it completes.
If _tos is non-empty, transfer either reverts or returns true and does not modify caller's balance (InvMutTest balance unchanged by the call).
If _tos is non-empty and v is zero, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (never returns false).
When given a non-empty _tos and any inputs, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false) — proven for the restricted case v == 0.

For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer returns true and either all external calls to the target caddress succeeded (so transfer returns true) or the function reverts; thus when it returns, it must be true and have attempted a call for each _tos element.
For any non-empty _tos with length 1, a non-reverting call to transfer returns true.
If transfer is called with a non-empty _tos array and does not revert, it must return true.
For any single-recipient non-empty _tos array, a non-reverting transfer call must return true.
